object_context: In one exact infinite-volume Wilson lattice Yang-Mills theory at fixed lattice spacing and strong positive coupling, determine whether the SZZ common exponential covariance exponent for smooth cylinder functions can be bound through reflection positivity/Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction to the positive physical transfer operator on a dense centered gauge-invariant source set, yielding a fixed-cutoff physical transfer spectral gap. This atom explicitly excludes RG transport, a->0 continuum scaling, continuum existence, and the Clay root.
structural_coordinates: Wilson lattice Yang-Mills Gibbs measure on Z^d with compact gauge group SU(N) or SO(N)
positive coupling beta in the SZZ strong-coupling regime
infinite-volume local weak limit measure mu_N,beta
reflection positivity on gauge-invariant positive-time cylinder algebra
OS Hilbert space as null quotient/completion of positive-time local observables
one-step Euclidean time translation represented by physical transfer operator T
centered source vectors spanning/dense in Omega-perp
SZZ source-independent covariance exponent c_N>0 with source-dependent finite prefactors
support distance under n-step time translation grows n+O(1)
fixed lattice spacing a and no continuum/RG transport
equivalent_formulations: For every centered gauge-invariant positive-time smooth cylinder F, show <psi_F,T^n psi_F> has limsup nth-root <= exp(-c_N), with the source vectors dense in the excited OS Hilbert space.
Show the SZZ covariance bound plus OS reflection/translation identity satisfies the hypotheses of YM-S1A1-C001-v2 with a common q=exp(-c_N)<1.
At fixed a, establish Spec(T|Omega-perp) subset [0,exp(-c_N)] and hence a lattice Hamiltonian gap at least c_N/a, while keeping G5-G7 open.
solved_analogues: Luescher 1977 constructs a self-adjoint strictly positive transfer matrix for Wilson lattice gauge theory at finite lattice cutoff and reconstructs Euclidean expectations as transfer-matrix Schwinger functions.
Osterwalder-Seiler 1978 verify physical positivity and a positive self-adjoint transfer matrix for lattice gauge theories and establish strongly coupled infinite-volume lattice Yang-Mills results.
YM-S1a1-C001-v2 proves the abstract dense-source common-rate positive-transfer spectral exclusion lemma.
near_solved_analogues: Shen-Zhu-Zhu 2023 prove a common exponential covariance exponent for all smooth cylinder functions of the unique strong-coupling infinite-volume lattice Yang-Mills measure, but phrase the result as Euclidean exponential clustering rather than an explicit OS transfer-spectrum theorem.

explicit_disanalogies: Euclidean exponential clustering is not automatically the Clay continuum mass gap without reflection-positive transfer-spectrum identification.
A strong-coupling fixed-a gap does not survive a->0 unless a dimensionful lower bound is uniform/scales correctly.
SU(N)/SO(N) strong-coupling coverage is narrower than the official all-compact-simple-group root.
The Langevin generator Poincare gap is not the physical Hamiltonian gap.
Finite-volume transfer positivity is not by itself an infinite-volume same-theory source-density statement.
Wilson-loop area law/confinement is not substituted for full excited-spectrum control.
